title: 第531章 又带回来了一坐骑第531章 又带回来了一坐骑
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: 不过，麒麟始祖这里，并没有多么难受。
反而，很兴奋！
因为，他极尽升华的力量，终于可以展现出来了！
这种感觉，让他感觉久违而又陌生，再一次感受到自身强大的气血与力量，他怎能不激动！
当然，还有另外一点，那就是他灭的是这天人族！
他与这天人族那位始祖，曾经可是大敌！
只不过，后来对方在岁月之中消失了，自己也不确定对方是死是活，究竟去了哪里，是否陨灭。
如今，他能够亲自过来出手，自然很激动。
因为，他心中很清楚，若是没有靠着孟尘这尊恐怖的大腿，即便是以他的身份，也绝对不敢招惹天人族！
这天人族太过自视甚高，底蕴恐怖，而且极为护短！
平日里。
仙界之中的那些势力，没有几个敢与他们招惹。
而天人族，更没少给他们这些势力脸色看！
如今！
他借刀杀人，灭了一个分族，简直大快人心！
“前辈，这天人族已灭！”
麒麟始祖转过身，对着孟尘卑躬屈膝地邀功。
孟尘淡淡点头，神色依旧平静。
他对于这天人族，记忆之中也有了解，此族比那祭天族还要尊高，将自己视为这世界的原住民。
他们，才是仙！
其他势力，不是。
虽然，天人族不会嘴上提及这些，但在他们的心底，却是这么认为的。
而眼下，这被灭掉的，也只是天人族的一个分族罢了。
一个分族之中的人，便可与三十三天的众多天之骄子并立，可想而知这一族有多么底蕴深厚了。
也难怪，这麒麟始祖如此人物，面对这天人族，还会如此激动。
看来，当年似乎没少被这天人族的强者给针对过。
“下一个。”
麒麟始祖不敢有丝毫怠慢，再次驮着孟尘，朝着下一个目标疾驰而去！
闪电族！
魔蛛族！
content_en:
However, Qilin Ancestor did not feel that uncomfortable here.
On the contrary, I am very excited!
Because, his sublimated power can finally be displayed!
This feeling made him feel unfamiliar and unfamiliar for a long time. How could he not be excited when he felt his powerful blood and strength again!
Of course, there is another point, that is, he is destroying this human race!
He and the ancestor of the human race were once great enemies!
However, the other party later disappeared in the years, and I was not sure whether the other party was dead or alive, where he went, and whether he perished.
Now that he can come and take action in person, he is naturally very excited.
Because he knew very well that if he hadn't relied on Meng Chen's terrifying thigh, even with his identity, he would never dare to provoke the Celestials!
Today, the human race thinks too highly of itself, has a terrifying background, and is extremely protective of its shortcomings!
On weekdays.
Few of the forces in the fairy world dared to provoke them.
As for the Celestial Race, they showed no less shame to these forces!
now!
He killed someone with a borrowed knife and wiped out a branch of the clan. It was so satisfying!
"Senior, the human race has been destroyed today!"
The ancestor of Qilin turned around and bowed to Meng Chen to ask for credit.
"Yeah."
Meng Chen nodded lightly, his expression still calm.
He also knew about this Celestial Clan in his memory. This Clan was more noble than the Celestial Clan, and regarded themselves as the aborigines of this world.
They are the immortals!
Other forces, not.
Although the Celestials would not mention this verbally, they thought so in their hearts.
And right now, the one being wiped out is just a branch of the Celestial Race.
A person in a branch clan can stand side by side with many of the proud men of the Thirty-three Heavens. One can imagine how profound this clan is.
It's no wonder that such a person as the Qilin Ancestor would be so excited when facing this human race.
It seems that many powerful people from the human race were targeted back then.
"Next one."
"Yes!"
The ancestor of Qilin did not dare to neglect at all. He once again carried Meng Chen on his back and galloped towards the next target!
Lightning clan!
Demon spider clan!
